Eleventh development release of 0.19.0: templates that write several files, local config context on devices and VMs, BGP maximum-prefix options, a working topology report behind nginx and a security fix.

> [!CAUTION]
> **This is a development release. It is not stable and it contains bugs.** Do not run it in production or on data you can't restore. Take a backup before upgrading a test install, and expect behaviour to change before 0.19.0. If you run into a problem, please [submit a bug report](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) - every report helps get 0.19.0 right.

> [!NOTE]
> **One root step after upgrading (systemd installs).** nginx now lets Danbyte frame its own pages (`X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`, `frame-ancestors 'self'`), which the topology report needs. Until root has re-rendered the site from this release's bundle, the topology report stays at *Drawing…*. The *After this upgrade* card now includes the commands to download the bundle again, because an upgrade from the app deletes the uploaded one. If you manage nginx yourself, change `DENY` to `SAMEORIGIN` and `frame-ancestors 'none'` to `frame-ancestors 'self'`. Docker installs need nothing.

### New

- **Several files from one template** - a config template whose target path ends in `/` writes one file per `{% file "name" %}…{% endfile %}` block. Each file has its own path, hash, drift and diff in the render, the API and the tar download. File names that could leave the directory, duplicate names and text outside the blocks are refused.
- **Local config context** - devices and VMs get *Local context data*, merged after every matching config context. The Config panel lists each source in merge order.
- **Config context by tag** - a config context can match devices by tag; one matching tag is enough.
- **BGP maximum-prefix** - a warning threshold (%), a restart interval and a warning-only switch next to *Maximum prefix*, inherited from groups and templates the same way. Values kept in `extra` are copied in.
- Templates' `link_peer` includes the far port's `mac_address` and `mtu`.

### Security

- **Fixes** deleting a certificate issuer leaving its ACME account key in the secret store. The key is now removed with the issuer, in bulk deletes too.

### Fixed

- **Fixes** the topology PDF report never finishing behind nginx (see the note above).
- **Fixes** a platform, manufacturer or other catalog entry with a name already in use being saved under a new slug. A taken name is refused on create, and entries that already share a name can be edited again.
- **Fixes** text overflowing the rack card in the 3D floor plan.

### Behaviour changes

- Creating a catalog entry with a name that's already in use answers **400** on `name`, even when a different slug is given.
- Two templates in one bundle writing the same path is an error instead of the second overwriting the first.
